question: AICC (All India Congress Committee) passed the Quit India Resolution on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**8th August, 1942**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Quit India Resolution** was passed by the **All India Congress Committee (AICC)** on **8th August, 1942**.
 
• This movement was a significant part of the Indian independence struggle, calling for an end to British rule in India.
 
• The Quit India Movement was launched under the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi, who gave the famous call to "Do or Die" in his speech delivered at the Gowalia Tank Maidan in Mumbai.
 
• The British government responded with mass arrests and severe repression, but the movement continued to gain momentum and widespread support across the country.
 
• The Quit India Movement marked a crucial turning point in India's fight for independence, eventually leading to the country's freedom in 1947.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Quit India Movement** is also known as the **August Kranti Movement**.
 
• It was one of the largest and most widespread movements against British rule in India.
 
• The movement saw participation from people across different sections of society, including students, workers, and peasants.
 
• Despite the harsh measures taken by the British to suppress the movement, it played a significant role in uniting Indians in their struggle for freedom.
 
• The movement also highlighted the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi and his philosophy of non-violent resistance.
